title: Dedicated onboarding gatekeeper and scaling sieve for provisioning approvals
creator: Anjali Mehra
description:
Problem: Large enterprise customers are requesting committed throughput with complex autoscale needs. Current intake is manual, error-prone, and decoupled from autoscale policies and fleet health signals. We need an intake "gatekeeper" that scores requests, maps requested throughput to fleet capacity profiles, and produces approval recommendations tied to concrete autoscaling and guardrail configs.

Objectives:
- Create a repeatable intake workflow that converts a customer commitment (throughput SLA, burst windows, region constraints) into: a capacity footprint estimate, recommended autoscale policy, minimum fleet reservation, and a canary rollout plan.
- Implement a scoring sieve to triage requests (proof-of-need, business criticality, expected QPS, memory/latency sensitivity) so high-risk/high-impact requests surface for manual review.
- Provide clear approval artifacts for Sales/Revenue Ops/Infra: delta in GPU hours, estimated cost delta, suggested SLA tier and fallback model variants.
- Integrate with the Dedicated provisioning system so approved requests create a preflight plan (reservation + autoscale policy + canary assignment) in the provisioning queue.

Deliverables:
1) Intake form schema (Confluence doc) + scoring rubric for automated triage.
2) Autoscale policy templates mapped to common workload archetypes (low-latency chat, high-throughput batch embeddings, mixed).
3) Capacity estimator that outputs GPU-pool sizing and estimated incremental cost.
4) Approval payload generator that creates a provisioning ticket for Infra with attached canary plan and rollback criteria.

Acceptance criteria:
- Intake can be submitted via Console or a Sales-facing form and produces a deterministic score and capacity estimate within 2 minutes.
- >90% of typical inbound requests map to one of the autoscale templates with recommended parameters.
- Provisioning tickets include an autoscale policy and a canary allocation that Infra can action without additional discovery questions 80% of the time.

Notes & constraints:
- This ticket focuses on policy and UX; infra automation (actual cluster allocation) will be done in follow-up ENG tickets.
- Must align with existing SLA tiers and pricing model.
- Security review not required for the intake schema, but any customer-sensitive data flow must be documented for Private customers.
